factual_claims.claim: The supermarkets segment increased revenue 0.3% to €611.9 million, but net profit fell 38.6% to €9.5 million as sales volumes declined, promotional activity increased and Jõgeva Selver’s renovation caused one-off costs and temporarily disrupted sales.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Supermarkets section reports revenue of €611.9 million (0.3% increase) and net profit of €9.5 million (38.6% decrease), citing declining sales volumes, increased promotions, and renovation-related costs at Jõgeva Selver.

factual_claims.claim: Department-store revenue fell 1.1% to €103.0 million and its net loss widened to €0.5 million, partly reflecting consumer caution, high price sensitivity and weak demand for winter goods during unusually warm fourth-quarter weather.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Department Stores section states revenue of €103.0 million (1.1% decrease) and a loss before tax of €0.5 million, attributing it to consumer caution, price sensitivity, and warm weather impacting winter goods demand.

factual_claims.claim: Security revenue declined 8.1% and the segment recorded a small loss, while real-estate revenue rose 5.1% to €7.7 million and net profit increased 20.5% to €6.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Business Segments table shows Security revenue of €20.1 million in 2025 vs €21.9 million in 2024 (8.1% decrease) with a net loss, and Real Estate revenue of €7.7 million vs €7.3 million (5.1% increase) with net profit of €6.3 million vs €5.2 million (20.5% increase).

factual_claims.claim: Cost control partly mitigated the revenue decline.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Management Report emphasizes effective cost control and stable operating expenses despite revenue declines.

factual_claims.claim: Staff costs rose 3.7%, but other operating expenses increased only 0.2%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Financial Performance section states labor costs increased by 3.7% for the year, while other operating expenses grew by 0.2%.

factual_claims.claim: Lower borrowing interest reduced finance costs by €1.5 million, and income-tax expense decreased by €1.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Financial Performance section notes finance costs were reduced by €1.5 million due to lower borrowing interest, and income-tax expense decreased by €1.2 million.

factual_claims.claim: Nevertheless, 2024 included €4.0 million of one-off gains from investment-property revaluation and property disposals, making the comparison less favourable.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Financial Performance section states the comparative base year (2024) included one-off profits of €4.0 million (€2.1 million from investment property revaluation and €1.9 million from property disposals).

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow decreased to €65.6 million from €73.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Consolidated Cash Flow Statement shows operating cash flows of €65,613,000 in 2025 vs €73,064,000 in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Total investments were €25.5 million, down from €36.6 million, focused on store refurbishments, digital systems, car dealerships and real estate.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Investments section states total investments were €25.5 million in 2025 vs €36.6 million in 2024, with details on store refurbishments, digital systems, car dealerships, and real estate.

factual_claims.claim: Cash fell to €29.5 million, and working capital became negative at €14.2 million, largely because €32.1 million of loans maturing in 2026 were classified as current; refinancing was planned and management reported no liquidity issues.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 5 (Cash and cash equivalents) shows €29,516,000 at 31.12.2025. Note 4 states working capital was negative €14,161,000. Note 15 explains €32,129,000 of loans maturing in 2026 were classified as current, with refinancing planned and management confirming no liquidity issues.

factual_claims.claim: A €11.2 million property revaluation gain increased total comprehensive income to €28.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Other comprehensive income in the Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income was €11,172,000. Total comprehensive income for 2025 was €28,699,000.

factual_claims.claim: After year-end, the Group agreed to acquire Škoda-related businesses in Estonia, subject to completion conditions, supporting its strategy to expand the automotive segment.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Event after the Reporting Period section details the agreement to acquire Rohe Auto AS and SKO Motors OÜ, subject to conditions, as part of the Group's strategy to strengthen its automotive segment.
